name: Banyan Tree Hangzhou
positioning: Spa resort in traditional Jiangnan architecture, set as a water village in the Xixi Wetlands Nature Reserve, 7 km from central Hangzhou
best_for: Couples wanting suites and villas with wetland views
Families or two couples travelling together who want a villa with an outdoor jetpool
Travelers who want nature and spa time close to Hangzhou's temples and West Lake

facts.text: The resort is a water village set in the Xixi Wetlands Nature Reserve in Hangzhou.
The resort is built in traditional Jiangnan architecture amid water village surroundings.
Xixi Wetland is a 5-minute walk from the resort.
The resort is 7 km from the city centre of Hangzhou.
Lingyin Temple, the oldest Buddhist temple in Hangzhou, is around 5.5 km from the resort.
The Premier Water View Villa has a private courtyard and views of the wetlands or lake.
The Premier Water Terrace Suite has an in-room bathtub and a private spa treatment room.
The three-bedroom Ambassador Villa is set by a scenic riverbank and welcomes guests with an in-villa banquet in the tradition of Chinese feasts.
The resort has an indoor swimming pool and a fitness centre.
The library has a selection of classic novels and retro decor including an antique typewriter and a vintage phonograph.
Wellbeing activities include baduanjin, biking and yoga, including a leisurely bike ride around Xixi Wetland.
Bai Yun is a Chinese restaurant serving authentic local Hangzhou dishes.

highlights.text: The Two-Bedroom Family Villa has a large outdoor jetpool, heated floors and deep bathtubs.
The Water Terrace Suite - King has a fireplace, a balcony and wetland views.
The Banyan Tree Spa's signature Banyan Balance treatment uses locally sourced Longjing tea.
Afternoon tea is served aboard a traditional Jiang Nan sculling boat cruising the lake.
On the Fisherman's Journey guests take a sculling boat to fish with local boatmen and pick vegetables, then eat a lunch cooked with their catch.

considerations.text: The resort is in the Xixi Wetlands, not on West Lake; West Lake is approximately 6.5 km away.
Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport is about 43 km away, approximately a 1-hour drive.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
